text:
Residents:
Tomas works from home weekdays 9:00-17:30, usually in the office. He is sometimes out for lunch. Weekends he sleeps in, does errands midday, and stays home otherwise. Hobbies: gym, jigsaw puzzles.
Ines is retired. Weekdays she is home most of the day, taking a morning walk and doing afternoon errands. Weekends she is home most of the day with a late-morning walk. Hobbies: gym, houseplants, reading. She looks after the dog.

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their initial walkthrough locations unless noted.

Kitchen/Dining Cycle:
- 19:00: Cooking prep. Knife, pan, pot, recipe book moved to counter.
- 20:00: Dinner setup. Plates, serving dish, glasses, water bottles moved to dining table. Knife to cupboard, pan to drawer, pot to dish rack, recipe book to pantry.
- 21:00: Cleanup. Most dishes (plates, glasses, mugs, pots, pans, bowls) moved to cupboard/sink. Knife and spatula to drawer. Serving dish to sink. Water bottles to counter/wardrobe. Snack bowl, remote, and mug_tomas moved to coffee table.
- 23:00: Late night. Glass_tomas to nightstand_b1. Mug_tomas, snack_bowl to kitchen_table/sink.

Living Room:
- 21:00: Blanket moved couch to coffee table. Remote and snack bowl moved to coffee table.
- 22:00: Blanket returned to couch. Remote moved to tv_stand.
- 23:00: Remote moved to side_table.

Entry/Personal Items:
- 11:00: Ines leaves for gym/errands. Leash, hats, jackets, keys, shoes, sunglasses, wallets, headphones, water bottle removed from house.
- 13:00: Ines returns. All items returned to entry spots.
- 17:00: Ines leaves again (gym). Items removed.
- 18:00: Tomas leaves (gym). Items removed.
- 19:00: Both return. All items returned to entry spots.

Office/Bedroom:
- 09:00-17:00: Tomas at desk. Laptop, mouse, pen, notebook, charger, water bottle, mug move between desk, floor, chair, and sink/counter.
- 18:00: Tomas leaves. Laptop to office_chair, mouse to floor, charger to bedroom_floor.
- 23:00: Charger and glass_tomas to nightstand_b1.

Static Items:
- Balcony: Gardening gloves, watering can.
- Bathroom: Detergent, hair dryer, laundry basket, toiletry bag, soap, toothbrushes, towels.
- Bedroom: Book, gym bags (Ines’s bag moves to wardrobe when she leaves).
- Dining: Vase.
- Kitchen: Kettle, plant pots, vitamins, wall clock, dog bowl, dog food.
- Living: Cushions, board game, picture frame, speaker, coasters, lamp, plant pot.
- Office: Plant pot.
- Storage: Ironing board, vacuum, toolbox.
